evidence.summary: The service-core integration suite passed 30 tests, including offline-edit reconciliation without cursor-only reuse.
Checkpoint schema mncs.workspace-checkpoint/1 stores compact source identities, generation, cursor, and stream identity.
The resident demonstration detected an offline edit after Language Service restart and surfaced UNKNOWN attention instead of PASS.

reproduction.instructions: Run the service-core integration test restart_reconciles_offline_edit_without_reusing_cursor_alone; then stop the resident host, edit a workspace file, restart it, and poll with the old stream identity. Confirm the same stream identity, a new cursor, reconciled=true, and incomplete impact.

summary: Restart state is now explicit: workspace checkpoints preserve source identities, generation and event-stream identity, and a restarted host emits bounded reconciled events for offline edits while preserving UNKNOWN until new proof exists.

workaround.description: The restart workaround is now implemented as the canonical checkpoint and stream-reconciliation path; transient event history remains bounded by design.
